profile_text.body:
STOPit Solutions describes itself as providing anonymous incident reporting and safety technology for the modern workplace, delivered through a mobile app, web, and phone hotline. The company says it works with more than 8,000 organizations nationwide to help protect their physical, social, and emotional well-being.

Its tracked product is STOPit, listed under education and research AI, an anonymous reporting app and hotline used by students and staff under a school license. The company's AI features are not verified. A signed California student data privacy agreement appears in the SDPC registry, tied to Westside Union SD in 2019. Pricing is about $1 per student per year, per Carroll ISD in Texas, and some state programs, insurers, and co-ops fund it.

The company is also identified as Lightspeed Systems (StopIt). No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers appear in the record.
